---
name: Independent replication report
about: Report an archival replay, model-side rerun, or prospective control, including negative results
labels: []
assignees: []
---

## Evidence level
- [ ] A — CPU archive replay
- [ ] B — Independent model-side rerun
- [ ] C — Prospective/stronger controls

## Status and summary
Reproduced / partly reproduced / diverged / blocked. Describe the main observation.

## Environment and provenance
OS, CPU/GPU, Python and dependencies, base-model/tokenizer revision, adapter/checkpoint hashes, source-file hashes, code commit, seeds.

## Protocol
Exact commands/notebook, prompts and templates, intervention selection, inference settings, scoring rules, controls, prespecified versus exploratory choices and deviations.

## Results
Link permissible raw data; list question-level outcomes, numeric discrepancies, paired effects and uncertainty; separate final-answer correctness from attenuation.

## Limitations and next steps
Missing reconstruction details, alternative explanations, negative findings, open questions.
